patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature comparisons and detailed explanations, often pairing a large visual or interactive element on one side with text and structured cards on the other.
Headings utilize an extremely bold, large sans-serif typeface for maximum impact and hierarchy, contrasting sharply with a more neutral, legible sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast palette of stark black, white, and subtle light grey is consistently punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon yellow for primary calls to action, key highlights, and interactive elements.
Sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, creating a dynamic content progression.
Key statistical claims and efficiency metrics are presented in a grid of distinct, card-like modules, each featuring a large, bold number and a concise descriptive label.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to primary navigation links as the user scrolls.
The hero section features a looping video background that plays continuously, providing dynamic visual interest and context behind the main headline and call to action.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade into view and slightly slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, impactful headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature a slight border-radius, appearing almost sharp but with a soft edge).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within card grids, creating an airy feel in some areas and a more compact density in others like the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-impact, almost brutalist typographic style for headings, combined with a striking, almost neon yellow accent color against a stark black and white palette, creates a memorable and energetic brand presence. The dynamic video hero and scroll-triggered reveals further enhance this modern, bold aesthetic.
